sections.name: main
sections.title: Main ingest run
sections.what: Reads each match file, sends it to the ingest step, counts matches and new incidents, prints a summary with attribution, and then closes the database connection.
sections.why: Brings the match data into the app's store and reports what changed.
sections.watch_out: An error stops the whole run and prints the error. The database connection is only closed on the normal path, so an error can leave it open.

summary: Loads downloaded Cricsheet match files into the app's incident store, one match at a time.
purpose: Brings the raw IPL ball-by-ball records into the database that the app reads from.
why: The app needs the match data stored locally before any model or report can use it.
how: Finds the match files in a folder (default or set by a flag), parses each one, sends it to the ingest step, adds up the matches and new ball records, prints a summary with attribution, and closes the database connection.
inputs: Numbered JSON match files in data/raw/cricsheet/ipl_json, or the folder given with the --from flag.
outputs: New rows in the incident store through ingestEvent, and a console summary with the match count, new incident count and the attribution line.
risks: Writes directly to the database. Rerunning is safe only if ingestEvent skips duplicates, and the printed new-incident count shows what was actually added.
debug: If nothing is added, check that the folder holds numbered JSON files. If the run stops early, read the printed error. Confirm the database setting is in place before running.
